```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)

library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggVennDiagram)
```

```{r}
crc_res_dir  <- "data/DE_results"
ucec_res_dir <- "data/DE_results/ucec_gene_DE"
plot_dir     <- "results/figures/DEG"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 1


read_deg <- function(file, contrast_name, flip_logfc = FALSE) {
  df <- read.csv(file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  if (flip_logfc) df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = contrast_name,
      sig = FDR <= fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) >= logfc_cutoff,
      direction = case_when(
        sig & logFC > 0 ~ "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
        sig & logFC < 0 ~ "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300))
    )
}


crc_mssh_vs_msih <- read_deg(
  file.path(crc_res_dir, "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H.csv"),
  "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",
  flip_logfc = TRUE
)

crc_mssh_vs_mssl <- read_deg(
  file.path(crc_res_dir, "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"),
  "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
  flip_logfc = FALSE
)


plot_volcano <- function(df, title, out_file, label_n = 12) {
  label_df <- df %>%
    filter(sig) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_n)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = Gene),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00",
      "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "log2 fold-change",
      y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, device = "svg")
  p
}

plot_volcano(
  crc_mssh_vs_msih,
  "CRC: MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",
  file.path(plot_dir, "volcano_CRC_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSI_H.svg")
)

plot_volcano(
  crc_mssh_vs_mssl,
  "CRC: MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
  file.path(plot_dir, "volcano_CRC_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.svg")
)


crc_sets <- list(
  "CRC: MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H" =
    crc_mssh_vs_msih %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene),
  "CRC: MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L" =
    crc_mssh_vs_mssl %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene)
)

p_crc_venn <- ggVennDiagram(crc_sets, label_alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#56B4E9") +
  labs(title = "Overlap of significant DEGs in CRC") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "venn_CRC_significant_DEGs.svg"),
  p_crc_venn,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  device = "svg"
)
```

```{r}
dir.create(ucec_res_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ucec_expected <- file.path(ucec_res_dir, c(
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H.csv",
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv",
  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"
))

if (!all(file.exists(ucec_expected))) {
  clinical_data <- read.csv(
    "data/ucec_clinical.csv",
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
    na.strings = c("NA", "")
  )
  rownames(clinical_data) <- clinical_data$sample_submitter_id
  clinical_data <- clinical_data[!is.na(clinical_data$MSI_TMB), ]
  
  counts <- as.matrix(read.csv(
    "data/UCEC/count_gene_name.csv",
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ))
  
  clinical_data$MSI_TMB <- factor(
    clinical_data$MSI_TMB,
    levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L"),
    labels = c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L")
  )
  
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(clinical_data))
  counts <- counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  clinical_data <- clinical_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  
  y <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB, min.count = 10)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
  
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
  colnames(design) <- levels(clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
  
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)
  
  ucec_contrasts <- list(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H, levels = design),
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design),
    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design)
  )
  
  for (nm in names(ucec_contrasts)) {
    qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = ucec_contrasts[[nm]])
    res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table
    write.csv(res, file.path(ucec_res_dir, paste0(nm, ".csv")))
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

crc_df <- bind_rows(
  crc_mssh_vs_msih,
  crc_mssh_vs_mssl
) %>% mutate(dataset = "CRC")

ucec_df <- bind_rows(
  ucec_mssh_vs_msih,
  ucec_mssh_vs_mssl
) %>% mutate(dataset = "UCEC")

all_df <- bind_rows(crc_df, ucec_df)
df <- all_df %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = str_replace(contrast, "^(CRC_|UCEC_)", "")
  )

shared_msih <- df %>%
  filter(comparison == "MSS/TMB-H_vs_MSI-H", sig) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(dataset) == 2) %>%
  summarise(
    CRC = logFC[dataset == "CRC"],
    UCEC = logFC[dataset == "UCEC"],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
shared_msih <- shared_msih %>%
  mutate(
    direction_crc  = sign(CRC),
    direction_ucec = sign(UCEC),
    consistent = direction_crc == direction_ucec
  )
shared_mssl <- df %>%
  filter(comparison == "MSS/TMB-H_vs_MSS/TMB-L", sig) %>%
  select(Gene, dataset, logFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = logFC) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CRC) & !is.na(UCEC))
shared_mssl <- shared_mssl %>%
  mutate(
    direction_crc  = sign(CRC),
    direction_ucec = sign(UCEC),
    consistent = direction_crc == direction_ucec
  )
```

```{r}
  pull(Gene)

msih_down_genes <- shared_msih %>%
  filter(consistent, CRC < 0, UCEC < 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)
```

```{r}
library(gprofiler2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

sources_use <- c("GO:BP", "REAC", "CORUM")


run_gost <- function(genes) {
  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
  
  if (length(genes) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  gost(
    query = genes,
    organism = "hsapiens",
    sources = sources_use,
    significant = TRUE,
    correction_method = "g_SCS"
  )
}

gost_msih_up   <- run_gost(msih_up_genes)
gost_msih_down <- run_gost(msih_down_genes)

gost_mssl_up   <- run_gost(mssl_up_genes)
gost_mssl_down <- run_gost(mssl_down_genes)
```

```{r}
extract_gost <- function(gost_res, comparison, direction, top_n_per_source = 6) {
  if (is.null(gost_res) || is.null(gost_res$result)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- gost_res$result %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
    filter(!grepl(
      "gene expression|transcription|RNA metabolic|cellular process|biological regulation|metabolic process",
      term_name,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ))
  
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    df <- gost_res$result %>%
      filter(!is.na(p_value))
  }
  
  df %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    arrange(p_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_per_source) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = comparison,
      direction = direction,
      neglog10_p = -log10(p_value),
      term_label = paste0(source, ": ", stringr::str_trunc(term_name, 70))
    ) %>%
    select(
      comparison,
      direction,
      source,
      term_id,
      term_name,
      term_label,
      p_value,
      neglog10_p,
      term_size,
      intersection_size,
      precision,
      recall
    )
}
```

```{r}
enrich_df <- bind_rows(
  extract_gost(gost_msih_up,   "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",     "Up in MSS/TMB-H"),
  extract_gost(gost_msih_down, "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",     "Down in MSS/TMB-H"),
  extract_gost(gost_mssl_up,   "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L", "Up in MSS/TMB-H"),
  extract_gost(gost_mssl_down, "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L", "Down in MSS/TMB-H")
)

enrich_df %>%
  count(comparison, direction)

sapply(
  list(
    msih_up = gost_msih_up,
    msih_down = gost_msih_down,
    mssl_up = gost_mssl_up,
    mssl_down = gost_mssl_down
  ),
  function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || is.null(x$result)) return(0)
    nrow(x$result)
  }
)

enrich_df <- enrich_df %>%
  arrange(comparison, direction, p_value) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Up in MSS/TMB-H", "Down in MSS/TMB-H")),
    comparison = factor(
      comparison,
      levels = c("MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L")
    ),
    term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(unique(term_label)))
  )

plot_one_comparison <- function(enrich_df, comparison_name, out_file) {
  df_plot <- enrich_df %>%
    filter(comparison == comparison_name) %>%
    arrange(direction, p_value) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Up in MSS/TMB-H", "Down in MSS/TMB-H")),
      term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(unique(term_label)))
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = direction, y = term_label)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = intersection_size, color = neglog10_p), alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#56B4E9", high = "#D55E00") +
    labs(
      title = comparison_name,
      subtitle = "Functional enrichment of shared CRC and UCEC DEGs",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      size = "Gene count",
      color = expression(-log[10](p))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 6, device = "svg")
  p
}

p_go_msih <- plot_one_comparison(
  enrich_df,
  "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",
  "results/figures/directional_enrichment_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSI_H.svg"
)

  enrich_df,
  "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
  "results/figures/directional_enrichment_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.svg"
)
```

```{r}
library(gprofiler2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
make_clean_enrichment_dotplot <- function(
    gost_res,
    title,
    sources_to_keep =  c("GO:BP", "REAC", "CORUM"),
    top_n_per_source = 10,
    min_term_size = 1,
    max_term_size = 500
) {
  df <- gost_res$result %>%
    filter(source %in% sources_to_keep) %>%
    filter(term_size >= min_term_size, term_size <= max_term_size) %>%
    filter(!grepl("gene expression|transcription|RNA metabolic|cellular process|biological regulation|metabolic process",
                  term_name,
                  ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    arrange(p_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_per_source) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10_p = -log10(p_value),
      term_label = paste0(source, ": ", stringr::str_trunc(term_name, 65)),
      term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(term_label))
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = neglog10_p, y = term_label)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = intersection_size, color = source), alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = expression(-log[10](p)),
      y = NULL,
      size = "Gene count",
      color = "Source"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r}
make_go_dotplot <- function(gost_res, title) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  
  df <- gost_res$result %>%
    filter(source == "GO:BP") %>%   
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%          
    mutate(
      neglog10_p = -log10(p_value),
      term_name = factor(term_name, levels = rev(term_name))
    )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = neglog10_p, y = term_name)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = intersection_size, color = neglog10_p)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#56B4E9", high = "#D55E00") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = expression(-log[10](p)),
      y = NULL,
      size = "Gene count",
      color = expression(-log[10](p))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
generic_terms <- c(
  "gene expression",
  "regulation of gene expression",
  "positive regulation of gene expression",
  "negative regulation of gene expression",
  "regulation of transcription",
  "transcription by RNA polymerase II",
  "RNA metabolic process",
  "cellular process",
  "biological regulation",
  "metabolic process",
  "macromolecule metabolic process"
)

clean_enrichment <- function(gost_res) {
  gost_res$result %>%
    filter(!tolower(term_name) %in% tolower(generic_terms)) %>%
    filter(term_size >= 10 & term_size <= 500)   
}
```
